The Real Problem
<em>Let's be real — you already know what marketing costs. That's why you're hesitant.

A freelance video editor: $500–$1,500 per video, and you're back in line next month for the next one. An agency retainer: $3,000–$10,000 a month, most of it going to account managers relaying messages, not people actually making things. A website agency: $5,000–$15,000 and a three-to-six month wait, for a site that still needs someone to figure out the funnel afterward. None of that is a knock on those people — it's just an expensive, disconnected way to get three things that need to work together anyway. We build all three as one system, using AI to cut the slow, expensive parts of production, so what used to cost a small team and $10K/month costs a fraction of that.
Learn how we work
Studio Thesis
Three things. Built to work together, not sold separately.
AI-produced video ads
Scripted, produced fast, finished by a human before anything goes live.
Websites built to convert

Our Full Marketing Toolkit
Everything a campaign needs — <em>under one roof
We don't hand you a strategy deck and disappear. We build the video, the site, and the funnel — and run the ads behind all three.
Script & Concept Development
Every ad starts with a script built around your actual customer, not a generic template.
Customer research & messaging angles · Multiple concept variations per project · Platform-specific hooks
AI-Assisted Video Production
AI handles the slow, expensive parts; a human editor finishes every version before it goes live.
Rapid first-draft generation · Human review & finishing on every video · Full set of variations to A/B test
Platform-Ready Delivery
Every ad delivered in the exact formats each platform needs.
Vertical, square & widescreen formats · Captions & platform specs · Upload-ready files
Conversion-Focused Design
Every page built around what a visitor needs to see to take action.
User journey mapped before design starts · Mobile-first layouts · One clear call-to-action per page
Fast, Clean Development
No bloated builders that lose visitors before they see the offer.
Sub-3-second load times · Clean code, no plugin bloat · SEO-ready from day one
Full Ownership, No Lock-In
You get the actual site, not a rented template.
Full source files handed over · No platform lock-in · Editable by anyone going forward
Funnel Strategy
The path from "saw your ad" to "became a customer," mapped before a page is built.
Full funnel mapped · Offer structure reviewed · Drop-off points identified before launch
Follow-Up Sequences
Most leads don't buy on the first visit — this is what brings them back.
Automated email sequences · Retargeting for warm leads · Abandoned-cart recovery flows
Business Development Support
Groundwork to open new customer channels beyond the funnel.
Outbound outreach templates · Partnership & channel identification · Ongoing optimization from real data
Campaign Setup
Accounts set up correctly from day one, where most wasted spend happens.
Pixel/tracking setup · Audience & targeting structure · Budget allocation based on real goals
Ongoing Optimization
Checked and adjusted weekly, not set once and forgotten.
Weekly performance review · A/B testing · Budget shifted toward what's working
Plain-Language Reporting
You'll always know what was spent and what it returned.
Weekly plain-language reports · Direct account access · No jargon-filled PDFs

The questions you're actually asking
"AI-generated video always looks fake. Why would this be different?"
AI gets us to a fast first draft; a person edits and finishes everything before you see it. You're getting speed on production, not a robot's raw output as the final product.
"How is this so much cheaper than an agency?"
Agencies price around headcount and hours. AI cuts the hours on script drafts, initial edits, and variations, so the savings come from efficiency, not from cutting what you actually see.
"What if I've been burned by a 'marketing agency' before?"
You'll see the actual plan before any money changes hands, so you're deciding on something real, not a pitch.
"Do I need all three, or can I get just one?"
You can start with one. We'll tell you honestly which matters most for where your business is right now.
Not trying to be everyone's agency
Probably a fit if:
You have a real product/service with actual customers already, you've tried marketing before and it didn't go well, and you want to understand what you're paying for.
Probably not a fit if:
You want overnight viral growth with no budget behind it, you want to hand everything over and never look at a number again, or you're not ready to spend anything yet.

Studio Origins
Why a venture studio ended up doing marketing

Nairi is backed by a venture studio operating in America, India, and Dubai. Building other ventures kept surfacing the same problem: good businesses, real customers already, and marketing that was too slow, too expensive, or too disconnected to work. So this became one of the things we build — marketing the way we'd want it done for our own ventures. This isn't a freelancer working between other jobs — it's backed by a studio already running operations across three countries.
